description: Handy AI's bench weigh-in, the site's answer to "what is the best AI model right now". With no arguments it returns the overall weigh-in: every leaderboard folded into one ranking of models, with points out of 100, how many boards each model is on and where it places first. Pass "type" for one topic (coding, agents, math, reasoning, work...). Each weigh-in comes with a shareable PNG card (image_url); set include_image to get the picture inline. Use get_benchmark for one benchmark's scores.

include_image.description: Also return the weigh-in card as an inline PNG image. Default false; the PNG URL is always in image_url.

range.description: Only scores from Model Drops published in this window. Default: 12m, the same weigh-in /benchmarks shows.

type.description: The kind of benchmark: all (default, the overall weigh-in across every board), coding, agents, math, reasoning, work, knowledge, multimodal, long-context, instructions or cyber.

name: get_weigh_in
title: Get a Handy AI bench weigh-in
